## Docs checklist

- [ ] Event format / hashing changed → `docs/schema.md` and `schema/*.json` updated

- [ ] New component, trust boundary or data flow → `docs/design.md` and `docs/threat_model.md` updated
- [ ] User-visible change → `CHANGELOG.md` updated
